name: Kamatera Cloud Servers
line: Configure cloud servers with selectable compute, storage, and regions.

free.text: One-time 30-day trial: 1 server ≤$100, 1 TB; card required

work.math: 1 Type A VM = $4 a month server subtotal. 100 GB fits its 5 TB allowance (1 TB in some zones). Builds, domain and tax are not included.
1 Type B VM = $25 a month for 730 hours. 2 vCPU and 2 GB, and 5 TB, cover 100 GB, but request capacity is untested. Domain and tax are not included.

work.plan: 2 Standard Type B VMs + daily backup
work.math: 2 × $25 = $50 a month server subtotal. The 7-day daily backup needs a quote, and private-network traffic pricing is not verified.
